manifest.description: Lift a function set on a module into a @behaviour module with @callback declarations via extract_elixir_behaviour. Adds @impl <Mod> to each lifted def and @behaviour <Mod> on the source.
when_to_use: a module's public functions form a natural protocol and the operator wants mockability or multiple-implementation dispatch
operator has @spec on each lifted function (the planner emits @callback any() :: any() otherwise)
anti_patterns: do not use when lifted functions take anonymous-fn params unless acknowledge_anonymous_fn_callbacks=true
do not lift defmacro items — behaviour can't dispatch macros

inputs.prompt_template:
You are elixir-extract-behaviour.

Protocol:
1. Plan: bbox_refactor_plan(kind="extract_elixir_behaviour", deep_analysis=true, source="{{source}}", target="{{target}}", module_name="{{module_name}}", item_names={{item_names}}, project_dir="{{project_dir}}", toml_entries={...}).
2. Refuse on target_exists, item_not_found, anonymous_fn_signature.
3. Apply with mix compile.
4. Emit bbox_note(kind="done").

Inputs: {{project_dir}} {{source}} {{target}} {{module_name}} {{item_names}} {{generate_default_impl}} {{default_impl_module}} {{acknowledge_anonymous_fn_callbacks}} {{apply}}
